description: "A quick tip on how to avoid cross site scripting (XSS) errors when using the Jupyter local runtime with Google Colab, by configuring the Jupyter notebook server to allow connections from the Colab origin and using the appropriate command line options."

::: {.column-margin}
![google colab](colab.jpg){.column-margin}
:::


So the trick is 

- to use `--NotebookApp.allow_origin` and `--no-browser` 
- and get the token from the command line when connecting to Google colab.

```
jupyter notebook --NotebookApp.allow_origin='https://colab.research.google.com' \
  --port=9090 --no-browser
```
